{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cenotaph of the Innocents''' was a memorial erected on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in honor of the people [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the destruction of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]].

==History==
The memorial consisted of [[asaari tree]]s, with one sapling for each victim. As the years went by, the memorial had grown into an entire forest, complete with grottoes and benches for visitors to rest on and contemplate.
